intro.name: The beginning
intro.text: A second impossible object appears. Then a third. The villagers fear that powerful strangers know the island's location.

variants.text:
A second impossible object appears. Then a third. The villagers fear that powerful strangers know the island's location.
The Tribal Chief weighs suppression against inquiry; scholars, magicians, and naturalists disagree over what the object means.

A second impossible object appears. Then a third. The villagers fear that powerful strangers know the island's location.
An artifact among the Tree of Life's roots sparks concern that outsiders have disturbed a sacred place.

A second impossible object appears. Then a third. The villagers fear that powerful strangers know the island's location.
Villagers and Isolans accuse one another of concealing artifacts.

a1.text: Watch posts and patrols are organized.

a2.text: A lookout mistakes an animal for an invader, causing panic.

a3.text: A patrol discovers signs of an unfamiliar landing party.

a4.text: The preparations exhaust food and labor; nobody arrives.

b1.text: Explorers discover an old wreck with more impossible objects.

b2.text: A cave contains a secret collection of strange artifacts.

b3.text: An unfamiliar campsite appears recently abandoned.

b4.text: The objects may have washed ashore from a distant land.

c1.text: The elders conceal the relics, but rumors persist.

c2.text: A researcher records the discovery despite an order of silence.

c3.text: Someone steals a relic for personal gain.

c4.text: A child innocently reveals the secret to everyone.

d1.text: A great shore signal receives no answer.

d2.text: A distant light appears over the water.

d3.text: An unfamiliar object appears in apparent response.

d4.text: The signal attracts attention the elders deeply regret.

coda_p6.text: Secret Society: Researchers meet privately to study the objects.

coda_p7.text: The Great Panic: Rumors disrupt work and empty the village stores.

text_only.reason: a large food loss, never below zero

coda_p8.text: First Contact: evidence shows the object was deliberately left by someone who knows Isola exists.
